author: musho7-dev
subject: Smooth movement of other players' cars in online races
body:
- Positions carry the sender's physics-step time; others replay them on that
  timeline (120 ms behind), not by arrival time, so Wi-Fi delays don't jerk the car
- Other cars are placed in the physics step with a per-step clock (the wall clock is
  the same for both physics steps of a frame, which made cars stop-and-jump)
- Late message: keep moving along the last direction up to 120 ms
- Self-test measures the other car's jitter (10.9 px -> 0.12 px per step)
